chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Aslam, from Ibrahim ibn Ayyub, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام), who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) said regarding His, the Exalted's, saying:
Indeed in that are signs for the discerning.
He said: The Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) was the discerner, and I am after him, and the Imams from my offspring are the discerners.
And in another copy: from Ahmad ibn Mihran, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn Aslam, from Ibrahim ibn Ayyub, through his chain, similarly to it.

key_terms.آيَاتٍ: signs indicating divine truth and guidance
key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), identified here as the foremost discerner
key_terms.ٱلْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams from the progeny of Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام)
key_terms.ٱلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ: those who discern signs and perceive realities by their marks

ai.seo_question: Who are the "discerning ones" mentioned in the Qur'an according to Imam al-Baqir and Amir al-Mu'minin (عليهما السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse as referring to those granted true discernment of divine signs. Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) identifies the foremost of them as Rasul Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله), followed by himself and the Imams from his progeny. It presents the verse within the framework of the authority and insight of the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام).

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Aslam, from Ibrahim Bin Ayoub, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>
having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Regarding the Words of the Exalted [15:75]
Surely, in this are Signs for the distinguishers (of the marks).

He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> is the distinguisher, and I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> from after him<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>, and the Imams<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> from my<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> offspring are the distinguishers’.
And in another copy, from Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Aslam, from Ibrahim Bin Ayoub, by his chain – similar to it.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Aslam from Ibrahim ibn Ayyub from ‘Amr ibn Shamir from Jabir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) has the following about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
““In this there is evidence (of the Truth) for the distinguished ones.” [15:75]
The Holy Prophet (s.a.) was the distinguieshed one and I was as such after him and the Imams from my children are the distinguieshed ones.”
In a different copy it is narrated from Ahmad ibn Mahran from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn Aslam from Ibrahim ibn Ayyub through the chain of his nnarrators a similar Hadith.
